policy.realPrompts: Use fixed low-cost ping prompts only. Do not run load tests from this matrix.
policy.streamEvidence: Store only stream summaries from scripts/smoke/stream-probe.mjs, never full provider streams.
policy.secretPolicy: No provider tokens, OAuth raw responses, or response bodies are stored in evidence.

evidenceStates.contract_verified: Local tests and fixtures passed; no real upstream success is implied.
evidenceStates.live_verified: Configured real routes passed with RUN_REAL=1 and no skipped matrix inputs.
evidenceStates.blocked_inputs: Required credentials, share bindings, external URLs, or verification prerequisites were unavailable or incomplete.
evidenceStates.failed: A required contract or live probe failed.

cursorImplementation.scope: single explicitly bound subscription account per Provider; no account pool or cross-binding fallback

kiroTextImplementation.scope: single explicitly bound subscription account per Provider; no pool, rotation, cross-account union, or cross-Provider failover

staticCoverage.notes: Local static adapter contracts are native for listed families. Kimi Claude uses exact native Messages/count_tokens endpoints with authoritative model discovery, bounded signed-thinking replay, generation fencing, and same-account 401 fixtures; real Kimi acceptance remains live pending. Qoder COSY Claude canonicalization, fixed-site signing, model/session/quota scoping, strict SSE terminal handling, and same-account pre-commit auth replay are fixture-verified; real Qoder acceptance remains live pending. Kimi/GLM/Alibaba/MiniMax/Volcengine/MiMo API-key coding-plan Profiles have fixed route/model/quota contracts; real subscription inference and quota remain live pending. Kiro Claude->CodeWhisperer non-stream/stream, absolute first-frame and terminal EventStream rules, tool gate, cross-region identity, fail-closed discovery, local count_tokens, and same-account 401 contracts are fixture-verified; real Kiro acceptance remains live pending. GitHub Copilot Claude->Chat non-stream/stream tool lifecycle, short-lived token-only forwarding, discovery, quota, and same-account 401 replay are fixture-verified Native; real github.com/GHES acceptance remains live pending. Cursor AgentService Claude text/image/tool emission, exact Provider/Account/Share/user session scope, initial and resumed absolute business-output deadlines, protocol-level builtin rejection, exact-scope credential/catalog caches, and same-binding 401/429 behavior are fixture-verified; Cursor remains Experimental/live-unverified until real validation.

Responses and Chat share the same provider family support. Qoder COSY Responses canonicalization, fixed-site signing, model/session/quota scoping, strict SSE terminal handling, and same-account pre-commit auth replay are fixture-verified; real Qoder acceptance remains live pending. Kimi/GLM/Alibaba/MiniMax/Volcengine/MiMo API-key coding-plan Profiles have fixed route/model/quota contracts; real subscription inference and quota remain live pending. Kiro uses the native Codex->Anthropic->CodeWhisperer bridge with fixture-verified non-stream/stream envelopes, absolute first-frame and terminal EventStream rules, cross-region identity, and fail-closed discovery; live acceptance remains pending. GitHub Copilot Responses->Chat non-stream/stream tool lifecycle, short-lived token-only forwarding, discovery, quota, and same-account 401 replay are fixture-verified Native; real github.com/GHES acceptance remains live pending. Cursor AgentService Responses lifecycle, exact scoped continuation/tool indexes, initial and post-tool absolute business-output deadlines, protocol-level builtin rejection, and same-binding credential/catalog/401/429 behavior are fixture-verified; Cursor remains Experimental/live-unverified.

Chat endpoint must stay in the matrix because Codex OAuth Chat->Responses routing is a production regression target. Kimi Chat uses the exact Coding Chat endpoint with authoritative model discovery, K3 effort normalization, bounded signed-thinking replay, generation fencing, and same-account 401 fixtures; real Kimi acceptance remains live pending. Qoder COSY Chat canonicalization, fixed-site signing, model/session/quota scoping, strict SSE terminal handling, and same-account pre-commit auth replay are fixture-verified; real Qoder acceptance remains live pending. Kimi/GLM/Alibaba/MiniMax/Volcengine/MiMo API-key coding-plan Profiles have fixed route/model/quota contracts; real subscription inference and quota remain live pending. Kiro Chat uses the native Codex->Anthropic->CodeWhisperer bridge with fixture-verified stream/non-stream envelopes, absolute first-frame and terminal EventStream rules, cross-region identity, and fail-closed discovery; real Kiro acceptance remains live pending. GitHub Copilot Chat forwarding shares the fixture-verified native Codex surface, short-lived token boundary, discovery, quota, and same-account 401 replay; real github.com/GHES acceptance remains live pending. Cursor AgentService Chat text/tool/finish/usage emission shares the exact scoped session, deadline, builtin-rejection, credential/catalog, and same-binding retry fixtures; Cursor remains Experimental/live-unverified.

streamGenerateContent bridge is covered statically for native OpenAI-compatible upstreams. GitHub Copilot Gemini->Chat non-stream/stream tool lifecycle, usage, single terminal, short-lived-token boundary, and same-account 401 contract are fixture-verified Native; real github.com/GHES acceptance remains live pending. Kimi Gemini uses the exact Coding Chat bridge with authoritative model discovery, K3 effort normalization, bounded signed-thinking replay, generation fencing, and same-account 401 fixtures; real Kimi acceptance remains live pending. Qoder COSY Gemini canonicalization, fixed-site signing, model/session/quota scoping, strict SSE terminal handling, and same-account pre-commit auth replay are fixture-verified; real Qoder acceptance remains live pending.
